prior_packet_role: authored content and technical scaffolding; never experiential acceptance evidence by itself

generic_primitives.evidence: Authored content with provenance, dramatic roles, surface projections, and an accessibility equivalent.
generic_primitives.conclusion: A case-specific platform input contract. Long accepted-answer sentences are human meaning examples only; runtime predicates use short components, exact fair artifacts, choices, matrices, or physical state.
generic_primitives.event: An idempotent local-primary state transition with consequence projections and outage recovery.
generic_primitives.theory: A player-held interpretation that may be acknowledged, contradicted, or recontextualized without becoming progress.
generic_primitives.projection: A release-bounded view of canonical content for Minecraft, Copperline, Discord, NPC, media, or catch-up surfaces.
